:::{#thm-answer-information}
#### The information in an answer is its entropy

Let $X$ be a [discrete random variable](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-discrete-rv),
and let $A$ be the [answer](#def-answer) to a [question](#def-question) about $X$.
If $X$ and $A$ have finite [entropies](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-entropy),
then the [mutual information](#def-mutual-information) between $X$ and the answer
is the entropy of the answer:

$$\mutinfof{X}{A} = \entropyf{A}.$$ {#eq-thm-answer-information}

:::

::: {.proof}

Given $X=x$, the answer $A = a(X)$ equals $a(x)$ with [probability](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-probability) $1$,
so $\P(A = a(x) \mid X = x) = 1$.
Hence the [conditional surprisal](#def-conditional-surprisal) of the answer $a(x)$ given $x$ is $-\log 1 = 0$,
and its [expectation](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-expectation) given $X=x$ is $0$:

$$\entropyf{A \mid X=x} = 0.$$ {#eq-thm-answer-information-2}

By @thm-conditional-entropy-average,

$$
\begin{aligned}
\entropyf{A \mid X}
&= \sum_{x} p(x) \, \entropyf{A \mid X=x} \\
&= 0,
\end{aligned}
$$ {#eq-thm-answer-information-3}

where $p(x) \eqdef \P(X=x)$.
By @thm-mutual-information-reduction with $Y = A$,

$$
\begin{aligned}
\mutinfof{X}{A}
&= \entropyf{A} - \entropyf{A \mid X} \\
&= \entropyf{A}.
\end{aligned}
$$ {#eq-thm-answer-information-4}

:::
